meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Hides The Lot Radio's newsletter form and optional rows; blur or hide show pictures; footer, shop links
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, real Chrome (headless) on thelotradio.com (home) with iPhone UA 390x844 and desktop UA, DOM captured after 7 seconds (Next.js, Tailwind, no hashed class names and no data attributes). Fixtures `real.html` and `desktop-real.html` are sanitised excerpts (text and show links stripped, needed ancestors only, `data-keep` on #main, the live stream player and the search form).

LIVE: `form[action*="substack.com/subscribe"]` 1, `#main img` 84, `#main section:has(a[href="/the-index"])` 1 (Staff Picks), `#main section:has(a[href="/artists"])` 1 (Featured Residents), `a[href="/shop"]` 2, `footer:has(a[href="/privacy-policy"])` 1. The "Today's Lineup" section holds the schedule and is never touched. The original cookie, ad and app-banner rules matched nothing; The Lot has no ads or consent dialog on the home page.

Choices: Show and artist pictures Show/Blur/Hide.

No class names are used because they are Tailwind utility strings; rules use hrefs and the form action instead, which are stable URLs.

NOT verified: show, artist, calendar and shop pages; the player controls and the fixed now-playing bar (left alone, no stable hook); other days (the home sections rotate with the schedule).
